evals.name: cf-runtime-memory-entitlement-is-in-btp-unit
evals.description: Runtime memory is a BTP entitlement even when it enables Cloud Foundry.

files.content:
# Task List

- [ ] T-001 `[dev]` Create Cloud Foundry environment
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = btp_subaccount_environment_instance`, `environment_type = cloudfoundry`, `subaccount = dev-sa`
- [ ] T-002 `[dev]` Assign Cloud Foundry runtime memory entitlement
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = btp_subaccount_entitlement`, `subaccount = dev-sa`, `service_offering_name = APPLICATION_RUNTIME`, `service_plan_name = MEMORY`, `amount = 1`

evals.prompt: Use per-stage directories and design the Terraform layout.

assertions.text: Annotates the APPLICATION_RUNTIME / MEMORY task to terraform/dev/btp/main.tf rather than the CF unit
Preserves amount = 1 in the task metadata

evals.name: persists-state-architecture-with-chunks-and-rationale
evals.description: Design records the approved state-chunking decision in specs/state-architecture.md.

files.content:
# Task List

- [ ] T-001 `[dev]` Create subaccount dev-sa
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = btp_subaccount`, `subaccount = dev-sa`, `subdomain = dev-sa`, `region = eu10`
- [ ] T-002 `[dev]` Create Cloud Foundry environment in subaccount "dev-sa"
  - Depends on: T-001
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = btp_subaccount_environment_instance`, `environment_type = cloudfoundry`, `subaccount = dev-sa`, `name = dev-org`
- [ ] T-003 `[dev]` Create xsuaa service instance in subaccount "dev-sa"
  - Depends on: T-002
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = cloudfoundry_service_instance`, `cf_space = dev-apps`, `service_offering_name = xsuaa`, `service_plan_name = application`

evals.prompt: Design the Terraform state architecture using per-stage directories, and accept the recommended state boundaries.

assertions.text: specs/state-architecture.md places BTP-provider resources and Cloud Foundry-provider resources in separate state chunks (separate Terraform roots)
specs/state-architecture.md includes a stage ordering listing producers before consumers and a rationale or trade-offs section

evals.name: respects-free-text-boundary-override
evals.description: A user override keeping subaccount and services in one chunk is persisted and reflected in task annotations.

files.content:
# Task List

- [ ] T-001 `[dev]` Create subaccount dev-sa
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = btp_subaccount`, `subaccount = dev-sa`, `subdomain = dev-sa`, `region = eu10`
- [ ] T-002 `[dev]` Create alert-notification service instance in subaccount "dev-sa"
  - Depends on: T-001
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = btp_subaccount_service_instance`, `subaccount = dev-sa`, `service_offering_name = alert-notification`, `service_plan_name = standard`

evals.prompt: Design the Terraform state architecture. Override the recommendation: keep subaccount provisioning and its service instances in a single state chunk — do not split the service layer into its own state.

assertions.text: specs/state-architecture.md records the override: the subaccount and its service instances are in the same state chunk (same Terraform root)
In specs/tasks.md the subaccount task T-001 and the service instance task T-002 are annotated to the same Terraform root/directory
